question: Which program should I start with?
answer: If you need more leads now and already have a website you're happy with, start with Core. If your website is outdated or you want to show up on Google, go with Scale. If you want to be the most recognized builder in your area, Elite covers everything. We'll help you decide on your strategy call.

question: I build ultra high-end homes. Is Core still a good fit?
answer: Yes. For ultra high-end builders, we may recommend Google Ads instead of Meta Ads at the Core level. Your market is smaller, so reaching homeowners who are actively searching for a builder works better. Everything else in Core stays the same.

question: Does ad spend come out of my program fee?
answer: No. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and Google and is separate from your BuilderLab program fee. Each program lists a recommended monthly budget.

question: How is my ad spend used across Meta and Google?
answer: Each platform has a different job. Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) build trust: they introduce you, show off your finished projects and teach homeowners about the homes you build, like lake homes or energy-efficient homes. Google Ads capture demand: they put you at the top of search results when homeowners are looking for a builder right now. Together, Meta builds the trust and Google catches the homeowner when they're ready to build.

question: What's the difference between the commitment options?
answer: The monthly price is the same. A 12-month program has no setup fee. A 6-month program has a $2,000 one-time setup fee, and month-to-month has a $5,000 one-time setup fee.

question: Is a website included?
answer: Website design, build and hosting are included in Scale and Elite. On Core, you can add a Premium Website ($3,995) or Boosted Website ($5,995) as a one-time project.

question: Can I upgrade later?
answer: Yes. Many builders start on Core and move up once their pipeline is full. Just tell your Growth Strategist and we'll plan the switch.

question: What guarantees do you offer?
answer: Two. Our 7-Day Alignment Guarantee: if we're not the right fit, get your money back within your first 7 days, no questions asked. And our 12-Month ROI Guarantee: if you don't see a return on your investment, we keep working for free until you do.
